jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Acme Freight is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer in Bengaluru.

What you will do

  • Build Java and Spring Boot microservices for our payments platform
  • Run event-driven distributed systems on Kafka, PostgreSQL and Redis
  • Ship to AWS and Kubernetes

What you bring

  • 5+ years building backend services in Java
